scope: All proposed audit fixes, performance work and UI redesign approved; final business choices to be asked one at a time.
style: Purple/violet rather than red; striking, educational, fun; journal layout reference retained.

attendance_late.answer: No Late option. Present = attended; Absent = last-minute cancellation/no-show; Cancelled = advance notice, may reschedule later.

attendance_denominator.answer: Present / (Present + Absent); Cancelled and unmarked excluded.

inactive_student_access.answer: Revoke student access immediately on deactivation; preserve history.

assignment_resubmission_grading.answer: Append-only versioned submission and grading history; newest graded version is current grade across all surfaces.

latest_ungraded_submission_display.answer: Only latest version gradable; previous versions read-only; latest awaits its own grade.

revenue_chart_basis.answer: Invoice billing month, not paid_at month. Add Financial History page, time series charts and all-history views.

financial_revenue_breakdown.answer: Revenue=Paid+Outstanding; canceled invoices excluded; group by billing month.

calendar_gestures.answer: Enable real persistence with confirmation before time/duration changes.

schedule_overlap.answer: Block overlaps across students for all scheduling write paths; ignore canceled bookings.

browser_reminders.answer: Remove reminder feature for now; in-app inbox remains.

grade_limits.answer: Numeric grades0..max inclusive; no extra credit.

new_holiday_existing_lessons.answer: Remove holiday feature and holiday recurrence logic entirely.

student_notification_events.answer: Every student-relevant change; numeric circular unread notification badge.

rescheduled_trial_pricing.answer: Preserve free trial flag and zero charge after rescheduling.

open_ended_recurrence.answer: Generate start date through December31 of that year by default, not8weeks.

source_fix_gate: Policy questions resolved; all fix batches approved; application implementation may begin. No push/deploy authorization.
